reason: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py:877-882, when enable_advanced_features is true and cursor.offset < 0 (accepted by Cursor.from_string at src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:51-58), OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result sets start_offset = cursor.offset and slices queryset[start_offset:stop], which raises Django's negative-indexing error on a QuerySet. Neither get_result nor Endpoint.paginate (src/sentry/api/base.py:540-541, which only catches BadPaginationError) catches this error, so it propagates to Endpoint.handle_exception_with_details (src/sentry/api/base.py:328) and returns HTTP 500.
